chunks: From him, from Ibn Mahboub, from Hisham ibn Salim, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him) who said:
That I should reconcile between two people is more beloved to me than that I should give charity with two Dinars.
ai.seo_question: Why is reconciliation between people considered better than charity in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (peace be upon him) elevates *sulh* (reconciliation) above the material act of giving two Dinars, emphasizing its unique capacity to restore social cohesion and prevent enmity. This hadith underscores the Shia scholarly view that repairing relationships is a higher form of worship because it addresses the root of communal discord, a virtue frequently linked to the concept of *sakinah* (tranquility) in Islamic jurisprudence and ethics.
